svg.aria-label: M-S-STALL seed 13, model-enabled live run: the page shows DK at tick 1881 because that reading is an RCT and the dragon-king test still holds on the extreme reading of tick 1641, which came before the stall.
svg.text: M-S-STALL, seed 13, model-enabled: why the live page shows DK at tick 1881
Run made by the user through the live page (rules first, qwen3:8b when a rule is insufficient). Source: results/live/dkrmm/api-6-8.json, DK-RMM's own readings; DK-RMM unchanged.
DK on the page = a reading DK-RMM calls RCT while its dragon-king test holds. The test is about the largest of the last 80 readings, not about the reading it is attached to.
1 The run: DK-RMM severity per reading (every 20 ticks) and the state the page shows
1641: 4.53, the largest reading of the run
Normal (before the stall): one task waited 47 ticks
dragon-king test holds on every reading from 1641 to 2101: 1641 is the largest of the last 80
the 80 readings the test reads at 1881: ticks 301 to 1881 (1600 ticks)
2 The dragon-king test, as DK-RMM recorded it (log value against log rank of the 12 largest; line fitted on ranks 2 to 12, rank 1 left out)
At 1881: rank 1 is the 4.53 of tick 1641
At 2441: ranks 2 to 12 are the readings after the release (2121 to 2401)
3 Why 1881 is an RCT, and why the page then writes DK
at least 1 kind held from the reading before
0.50 of the acting agents (exactly at the line)
dragon-king test OR critical slowing down
→ DK-RMM: RCT. The page: RCT with the test held, shown as DK.
The four kinds at 1881 come from the stall: retry +4.9, interaction density +9.5,
dependency graph +3.2, synchrony +3.4 standard deviations. The word DK comes from 1641.
What the 4.53 at 1641 is made of (severity = sum of
the 20 indicators' directional z-scores, divided by 20)
task wait p95: 47 ticks against a baseline p95 of 8 (ratio 5.875).
Waits of the 8 tasks started in that window: 1, 8, 1, 8, 1, 8, 47, 1.
The indicator's own baseline is 1.05 with almost no spread: +61 sd.
The extreme reading of this run is tick 1641, before the stall starts: the Normal facility, one task that waited 47 ticks. It stands far above the tail, so the test holds from 1641.
The stall makes 1861 to 1881 abnormal on four kinds at once; at 1881 the RCT rule is met and its precursor is the dragon-king test, still holding on 1641. The page therefore writes DK at 1881.
The release (3.23 and 3.77) is the stall's own extreme, but it stays below 4.53, and once it fills ranks 2 to 12 the fit explains 4.53 too: at 2441 the test no longer holds and that RCT stays RCT.
